title: Rooms and narrow spaces take their skylight from the world round them
summary: Rooms, wall feet, woods and gaps between houses lose skylight; reflections indoors lose the sky; fires glow on their surroundings; vehicles and men shade the ground round them; the bounce follows the time of day; open ground is unchanged.
stage: Frozen A/B captures (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE=<dir> FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE_AT=<s>, --fixed-fps 30, --set=light_probes:2). --scenario=breach --seed=3: midday room --mood=day --focus=0,-30 --zoom=8 --pitch=-62 at 5 s; rain the same with --mood=rain; golden --mood=golden --focus=0,-30 --zoom=12 --pitch=-40 --cam-yaw=0.5 at 5 s. --scenario=fire --seed=3: wood edge --mood=day --focus=-16,-27 --zoom=20 --pitch=-55 at 5 s; night fires --mood=night --focus=-6,-22 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 at 8 s. --scenario=showroom --static --seed=3: vehicles --mood=overcast (and day) --focus=-1,0 --zoom=13 --pitch=-50 at 8 s; crater --mood=overcast --focus=0,7 --zoom=9 --pitch=-45 --blast-at=0,7,3,3 at 10 s. --scenario=lean --static: men --mood=overcast --focus=0,-6 --zoom=9 --pitch=-55 at 8 s. Timelapse: --scenario=breach --static --seed=3 --mood=golden --set=light_probes:2,time_passes:true,eye_adapt:false FL_DEBUG_TOD_PACE=60 FL_DEBUG_TOD_AT=0, 96 shots every 0.25 s from 5 s; room --focus=0,-30 --zoom=8 --pitch=-62, street --focus=7,-31 --zoom=12 --pitch=-10. Destruction: --mood=day --focus=12,-31 --zoom=14 --pitch=-50 --blast-at=14,-29,3,6, 60 frames every 0.1 s from 5.5 s.
rationale: Each sheet is cropped tight on where probes matter. OFF and ON are adjacent frames (1/30 s apart) of one probes-on run that cycles the probes off, on, their term and the bent normal three frames each (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle), so smoke and men barely move between them; the probe term comes from the same run. The difference panel is ON minus OFF x4 around mid grey. The flicker clip alternates OFF and ON; the destruction clip pairs the game with the probe term from a second identical fixed-fps run (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=1).

capture.provenance: Recaptured off-screen from this branch (Forward+, RTX 3090, High preset) with the commands in stage; panels are consecutive frames of one fixed-fps run, so they share camera, units and smoke.
capture.comparison: Player sheets: top left probes off, bottom left on, top right the probe term (sky share on grey, bounce amplified), bottom right ON minus OFF x4 on mid grey. Review sheets (PR only) show the bent normal instead of the difference. Flicker: off and on alternate each second on one frame. Destruction: the game and the probe term from two identical fixed-fps runs.
capture.limits: Measured (linear light): the midday room falls to 0.75 of its brightness; its shade is 0.22 of the sunlit floor. In the rain the wet floor indoors falls to 0.29 as the sky leaves its reflection. Under the crowns the ground is about 19% darker and greener (green to red 0.95 to 1.10). Round the night fires the ground is up to half as bright again. Round parked hulls the ground is up to 39% darker overcast (darkest at the contact line, gone 1-1.5 m out), up to 26% in sun; a crater bowl about 6% darker than the field round it. Timelapse at 60x: from one frame to the next half the probe term changes under 0.3%, nine tenths under 1%, the worst frame 4% (at sunset); in play the clock runs 60 times slower. The flares the AI fires after dark (from about 19:30) light the room in the timelapse runs at different moments; the clip stops before them. The room-flicker clip is from an earlier pass. The Compatibility renderer (browser) gets the skylight shading, reflections, fire glow and footprints but not the indoor sun cut.

source_ref: dines/probe-grid-gi-0571ca: the time-of-day, vehicle and man occlusion and battle-damage pass, with rounded footprints and dusk fill, after 94966ca2.
